method.target: Canonical Vercel alias under vantage-4d3db9ef, database vantagemovers on the expected cluster SRV with TLS, writable primary, replica set name and all three SRV-advertised members verified. Indexed deployment stamp matched the Vercel deployment ID and historical release SHA before sampling.
operations: findOne deployment stamp via scope index
find latest 25 runs sorted by _id descending, hint _id_, return timestamps/status and four counters
aggregate jobs with _id_ hint, descending sort, limit 25, project $bsonSize of $$ROOT and {_id}, group counts and byte totals
method.limits: One native driver connection, 2000 ms per data read, no disk spilling, application bootstrap, customer payload output, writes or executionStats. Initial identity checks refused historical member names; current cluster SRV records, replica name and deployment stamp independently identified the target.
method.interpretation: Separate latest-record samples from the existing deployed application. Job sample includes stored rows irrespective of eligibility. The ID-only byte count is hypothetical. Multiple claims do not prove overlap. No measured release effect, distribution across a business day, total backlog or Google verification.
